title: How We Feel: store reference set
role_for_mira: Supplementary shape/color and cross-screen illustration-language reference.

provenance.platform: Android Google Play listing; build not identified
provenance.kind: marketing screenshots; not sequential flow evidence

target_reference.units: logical design units, not measured donor dp

spatial_ergonomic.measurement_basis: Qualitative visual reading of retained frames. Regions below are relative roles; source screenshots/GIFs do not expose device density or reliable native dp. Marketing/device chrome is not counted as app content.

regions.description: Outer headline and phone mockup are marketing composition, not native layout.
Inset screens show emotion shapes, entry cards, calendar, a content detail, and a social collection.

spatial_ergonomic.reference_zone_status: Proposed comparison grid only; donor controls may fall outside these bands. Not a fixed-coordinate implementation rule.

visual_density.value: Emotion and calendar insets are dense; outer marketing space is not an app open-canvas measurement.

states_and_triggers.limitation: Visible states are observations; documented arrows use source flow/guide descriptions. No event-handler names, gesture thresholds, or unseen screens are inferred as measured behavior.

observation.value: No motion or transition evidence; panels are not sequential states.

visual_or_documented_feedback.value: No haptic, sound, or gesture feedback evidence.

hierarchy.value: Shape/color vocabulary provides recognizable grouping across panels. Small labels, dense options, and store captions cannot establish readable native text sizes.

copy_and_cognitive_load.note: No OCR word-count or grade-level measurement is claimed. Use the Mira copy sheet for exact comparison text.

mira_synthesis_candidate.value: Explore a coherent visual vocabulary across the three surfaces. Do not import a mood tracker, social feed, forced dark palette, or a new emotion-input flow.
